performance.direction: The scene is tense and quiet in a wet cellar. Mara is scared and breathless, trying not to be heard. Elias is older, calm, and protective. Preserve each speaker's voice identity and do not change accent, age, or base tone.

turns.speaker: Mara
turns.text: Please, just stop. If they find out we are down here, I do not know what they will do to us

turns.speaker: Elias
turns.text: Then we breathe, and we move only when the corridor goes quiet
